intent: Independent broader re-evaluation of the previous improved code; no application fixes during this audit.
scoring: Within each category, compute the mean pass fraction across behavior families, then multiply by its 10-point weight. Repeated paraphrases or numeric variants do not add weight to that family. Report raw case pass counts separately.
rules: Freeze application sources before constructing or executing the new cases.
Use customer requirements and documented behavior as the oracle; do not update expectations to agree with implementation.
A failed assertion is a product failure; unexpected runtime errors remain separate and reduce the score.
If a case has an invalid fixture, correct setup only, document the correction, and rerun the complete final suite.
Do not weaken assertions, remove failing cases, or patch application code to obtain a perfect score.
Each category must have at least 20 cases spanning at least 5 behavior families.
Block real external API calls and notifications; report any attempted outbound delivery.
Distinguish pure function checks, agent simulations, and actual isolated HTTP API conversations.
Live model quality, production reliability, and real customer success are unmeasured, not passing.
